contract: Same immutable resident CSR, frozen reverse builder, common workspace and shared immediate exact-result reuse for ALL policies; reserve owned immutable full output before certificate publication. No prior history before first request. q means first request plus q followups. No fixed external A pipeline is claimed: each policy computes the same first source under its own algorithm. Do not pool old fixed-A timings.
primary_service_ns: Output pointer reserve, cold reverse construction if needed, workspace/cache allocation, all first+q complete owned outputs and publication/maintenance, executor/workspace/reverse teardown; excludes input loading/CSR construction, ready reverse historical construction, validation and final consumer output release
secondary: prepare_ns and queries_ns are direct subintervals; historical_prepare_ns separately measured; lifecycle_ns contiguous through ready history, service, TEST validation and output release. It is not validation-free production latency.
diagnostics_separate: Timed kernels use Diagnose=false; mechanism kernels use true in a separate process. Owned full outputs checked outside timing and after executor destruction.
pairing: Geometric mean of mirrored candidate/baseline ratios within session+round+fixture+schedule+q+path; 21 blocks, 3 sessions; no outlier deletion or outcome-dependent mode selection
gate: median ratio <0.95 and >=17/21 wins and each of 3 session medians <0.95
integration: Isolated research harness only. No changes to API/default modules/MAIN/vendor or intake files. Candidate helpers do not yet implement public API v1; no new replacement compatibility claim. Existing same-MAIN binary regression is rerun separately. Do not integrate without robust incremental service benefit and a compatible adapter.
